==Features and Overview==
==={{OoT|-}}===
{{Main|Spirit Temple (Ocarina of Time)}}
The Spirit Temple is located in the westernmost area of the [[Desert Colossus]] in the [[Haunted Wasteland]]. Its main [[Item]] is the [[Mirror Shield]] and its [[Boss]] is [[Twinrova]].

==={{TotK|-}}===
{{Main|Spirit Temple (Tears of the Kingdom)}}
{{Quests|

}}
{{TotK Quest
 |name= Trail of the Master Sword
 |type= Main Quest
 |giver= [[Mineru]]
 |location= Spirit Temple
}}
}}
The Spirit Temple is located in the [[West Necluda Depths]]. Its [[Boss]] is the [[Seized Construct]].
